name: wago-plc-mcp-server
description: Read and monitor WAGO PLC parameters over the WDA REST API. Read-only unless you allow writes.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to WAGO controllers (CC100, PFC100/200/300, Edge Controller, WP400, TP600) on your local network through the native WDA REST API over HTTPS.

**Read-only by default.** Parameter writes, method calls and file uploads are refused until you tick *Allow writes and method calls*. Reboot, factory reset and firmware methods stay blocked even then.

This bundle is for a single user and a handful of PLCs. For a shared or production fleet, run the Docker deployment instead: https://github.com/WagoAlex/wago-plc-mcp-server#deployment-options

plc_hosts.title: PLC IP addresses
plc_hosts.description: Comma-separated IPs of your WAGO controllers, reachable from this computer. Example: 192.168.1.10,192.168.1.11

username.title: PLC username
username.description: Web-based management (WBM) user on the controllers.

password.title: PLC password
password.description: Password for that user, same on all listed PLCs. Stored in your OS keychain.

timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: CC100 needs 45 or more; other controllers work with 15.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes and method calls
allow_writes.description: Off: every PLC is read-only. On: Claude can change parameters, run methods and upload files on the listed PLCs. Only enable for controllers you are allowed to change.
